scope: The shared command memory SELECT used by analyzeCMSStrategy and assessDiagnosticsValidation only.
canonical_fixture: Reader-facing columns are pinned to shared/schema.ts projectMemoryEntries, and every command SELECT executes in real PGlite. No obsolete columns or mocked SELECT rows are supplied.
contracts: Canonical confidence/importance aliases appear in real returned SQL rows.
Exact healthy CMS coverage, two keyword risks, and undefined complete-coverage recommendations are preserved.
Exact partial CMS category coverage and recommendation text are preserved.
Diagnostics retains its existing four-component keyword coverage math and public formatting.
Both callers use their unchanged five-category arrays, bound organization/project arguments, and limits of 18 or 20.
Both callers exclude pending_review, superseded, archived, rejected, null, and unknown top-level statuses; inactive-only projects retain healthy absence.
Severity uses critical/high/medium/low ordering case-insensitively with newest-first ties and null/unknown severity last.
Tenant/project isolation, explicit project override, and missing/nonnumeric project guards remain intact.
Real missing-table and missing-column errors use the existing failure results and never become successful empty reports.
limits: The private unused importance field is typed string | null to match the canonical text column; neither public result consumes confidence or importance numerically.
The diagnostics readinessScore remains an existing keyword coverage score. These tests do not establish scientific validation readiness.
Filtering applies to top-level status for this shared command SELECT; other readers and JSON-only review metadata are outside this batch.
